fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-09-08 states that the complainant received messages threatening to circulate private material online unless Rs. 25,000 was paid, on 2025-09-08 at roughly 17:50. Tamilselvi Devi approached Tiruppur South PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000452. Nithya Rani (9000000035) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complaint mentions Karthik Velan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000188, in connection with the events.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly used online messages to demand money.
fields.Keywords: blackmail, online threat, suspect, evening, witness, college road, mobile number, phone records
